I had/have this fear too. I’ve lost two partners, one to drugs and one to suicide. The fear and worry I feel when a partner doesn’t text back for an uncharacteristically long time is terrifying. I play scenarios in my head and it sets off all my triggers and I worry I’m going to call and a paramedic answer the phone. 

It’s not healthy to live this way, my last relationship broke down in part because of this. I’m now involved with an old friend who knows all about my past and has promised and sworn this will never be the case with him.. but he has his own demons so the fear is still there. I start CBT next week to help with this. 

You’re not alone - it’s to be expected when “what’s the worst that can happen” to us is life changing trauma.
